<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Employee or department"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitRequest" name="Submit IT solution request" sourceRef="Participant_Requester" targetRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_IT">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RequestReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssessRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcureTools</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InstallSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestSuccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RollOutSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RemainAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SupportAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="IT solution request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestToAssessment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess request for compatibility, cost, and resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestToAssessment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssessmentToApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssessmentToApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovalYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovalNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovalNo</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcureTools" name="Procure necessary tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovalYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcureToInstall</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallSolution" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcureToInstall</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InstallToTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSolution" name="Test solution in a controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InstallToTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestToSuccess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestSuccess" name="Testing successful?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestToSuccess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful" name="Testing not successful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestNo</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RollOutSolution" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RolloutToTrainingChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingChoice" name="Provide training?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RolloutToTrainingChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Continue after training choice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingMergeToSupport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemainAvailable" name="Remain available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingMergeToSupport</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SupportToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SupportAvailable" name="Support available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SupportToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToAssessment" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentToApproval" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovalYes" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_ProcureTools"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovalNo" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcureToInstall" sourceRef="Task_ProcureTools" targetRef="Task_InstallSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InstallToTest" sourceRef="Task_InstallSolution" targetRef="Task_TestSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestToSuccess" sourceRef="Task_TestSolution" targetRef="Gateway_TestSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestYes" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSuccess" targetRef="Task_RollOutSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestNo" name="Not successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSuccess" targetRef="EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RolloutToTrainingChoice" sourceRef="Task_RollOutSolution" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingYes" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingNo" name="Training not provided" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMergeToSupport" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_RemainAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SupportToEnd" sourceRef="Task_RemainAvailable" targetRef="EndEvent_SupportAvailable"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
